a.text: I was born in a small village a hundred li away from what is today Shangshu. It was a beautiful oasis.
If you gazed out from the village, you would see a range of mountains that formed a line. The line enveloped a swath of land named Shangshu.
There was a Catastrophe when I was young. The mountains covered a wide area, and the looming clouds covered an even wider area..

The Catastrophe Messengers were quick at their work. As we evacuated, we could see sparks lighting up the sky. All of us knew that Shangshu's Three Mounts would never look the same after the Catastrophe passed.
I was still very young. All I remember is the adults' swaying backs and their forced smiles.
The rescue team moved quickly, but all of us knew that the houses, the farms, and the orchards would all perish in the storm.
We passed a mountain on our way.
With my own eyes, I saw a drunken woman lounging in a pavilion.
I saw her share a toast with the sky.
I saw her fall unconscious in the pavilion, completely inebriated.
But the rescue team didn't stop. The adults around me pretended as though they didn't see her.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: ...A black goblet.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Was this the cup she drank from...?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Miss Li...

steps.name: Part-Timer
steps.text: Sir! Do you need something?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Can you describe the guest just now?

steps.name: Part-Timer
steps.text: Of course... I could never forget a Forte hunk like him...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Prepare two boxes of pastries and pay Miss Ning a visit.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: If Miss Ning meets with the Forte there... come back and let me know.

steps.name: Part-Timer
steps.text: Very well, though why aren't you—Uhh... My apologies, I shouldn't have asked. I will go right now.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, I asked around, and it seems we'll arrive at our rendezvous point if we follow this path up the mountain.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But suppose we really don't find anyone there, what should we do?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Then we'll just have to go back to the Liang estate to find Mr. Lee. He said Magistrate Liang asked him to look into the goblet's owner. We should help him out.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But what if Miss Du spoke the truth, and it was indeed a man of renown who seeks the cup...? Would Magistrate Liang truly know nothing of it?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But would that all of this was a mere premeditated conspiracy, why would Magistrate Liang need to go through the trouble and put on such a show?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's not like we haven't ever seen any big shots ourselves.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You mean the boy who claimed to be a Messenger...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Haha... If only the Doctor was around. We could've just handed all this trouble off.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *Sigh*... I miss the dorm's soft beds.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: *Sigh*... Why must we always mix ourselves up in trouble...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Finish your tea... It's time to go.

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: Should be around here...

steps.name: Hurrying Assistant
steps.text: Hot water coming through. Out of the way—

steps.name: Hurrying Assistant
steps.text: Hm! Watch out!

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) —Strewth! Don't scratch the paint, cobba.

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: A letter? From just now...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's past the rendezvous time. They really didn't come.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What should we do now? We don't know if Benefactor Lava has been to the office...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Perhaps we should wait a little longer?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Or we could meet up with Mr. Lee first—Hm?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: An Ink Spirit...?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hold on, hold on! Can those things leave the scrolls?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I have no idea myself...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey, little guy. Where did you come from? Where's your owner?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkhaa!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey, no biting! Let go! Let go!
You're the one who provoked it.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Bitey, that's enough.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Owie—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Dusk!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: We ran into a bit of trouble. You'll have to bear with me talking to you this way.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Trouble...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't worry about it. It's nothing you can help with.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: In Shangshu, we ran into some court envoys who're investigating what happened at Mount Hui-ch'i in Kou-wu City... They said they're from the Sui Regulator.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Tsk... I thought Nian would have everything sorted out by the time she came knocking on my door.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: It seems I should've kept my expectations low with the way she goes about things.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Did you fight them?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Heaven forbid we should try to tussle with the mandarins... Not that we would've won if we'd tried, haha...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They mentioned you and Nian, but it didn't seem like they were looking into you two too seriously.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They came to Shangshu on a different mission.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I don't know about that... Do you have any clues?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's got something to do with a black goblet.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Black... goblet.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: We're helping a certain Mr. Lee to look into the cup's master too. The cup looked like it had a pattern on it... Much like the trinket that Nian gave Benefactor Lava.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: A cup... No wonder something seemed strange... I have a pretty strong hunch as to who that cup belongs to.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: She can help us with quite a bit if we actually manage to find her. At the very least, she can help me keep Nian's mouth shut.
Dusk! Get out here already! The old fart's rambling away, he's really pissing me off! It's your turn!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Uhh... Is that Nian?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You must've misheard.
Heavenly forge—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: P-Perhaps we should keep you no longer?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You said you're looking for the master of the cup, weren't you?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Find her before the mandarins do. Persuade her to help us.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: At the very least, drag this out until we get to Shangshu. Don't let the Sui Regulator take her away.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm, we're back...?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, is it just me, or does this baffling trickery of Dusk's really come in handy?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's not worldly Arts anyway, so don't bother trying to learn it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But it is convenient, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're looking for a pavilion?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm guessing that a pole-carrier like you, having come up and down the mountains so many times, the range here must be like your own backyard.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Let me tell you, then. The Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks are full of pavilions, be it old rest stops or newly built scenic spots.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It's tough to find a specific one.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You can do it.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It'll take a lot of work, and I get paid by the trip, you know...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Not like anyone across the world would work for free.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Indeed. Here's your reward, then.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're from Lungmen?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yes, what should I call you, kind sir?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: The name's Shang... Like Shang-Qie.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What do you want me to do for you? Be your guide? Or do you want me to find somewhere that fits the description and report back?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Time is of the essence. It'll be for the better if we can split up.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're not from around here... and you're with a boatman?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I've spent a very long time in the rivers, and I am familiar enough with the area.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: The rivers are nothing like the mountain roads.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: They're both in Shangshu.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You can skip the Bieli, Ziyun, and Qingluan Peaks. They're just small peaks that people back in the old days decided to count toward the Seventeen Peaks.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Very well. We're actually focusing our search today on the Qujiang Peak here.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'd appreciate if you could find me some clues before sundown... and please do look out for any towns with famous wine shops while you're in the mountains.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Wine?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Aren't all those who frequent pavilions connoisseurs of drink? They're always passed out drunk in them.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll ask around, then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Much thanks.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: We'll meet in the teahouse there in the evening, then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Well, if you aren't a casual guy. You pulled a random person off the street and asked them to help you. Aren't you afraid of getting duped?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm a detective. Gotta take a risk every now and then.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Can we trust him?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just barely. He got attention from all the shopkeeps along the road. That means he's got decent relationships.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A pole-carrier who would swindle this little money wouldn't have such a good reputation in the neighborhood.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Besides, it's better than searching blindly.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You have a point... Where do we head next, then? Any clues?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A mysterious person that our magistrate insists is in Shangshu, their whereabouts unknown nonetheless, wouldn't hang out in a normal town like this.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So much of the problem lies in the cup.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Besides... If someone's bent on getting their hands on this no-name goblet, it only means that this little trinket is the key.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Master Shen, suppose the two of us run into the thieves from the other day. Do you think we can fend them off together?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*, I've spent a few decades on the rivers, and the only thing I've ever worried about is how my grandchildren are doing in school. I've never fought anyone, and it would be quite the problem if I ever ran into a bandit.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: All I can do is be your tour guide, kid. If you're worried, you'd better go to Mr. Liang soon and have him find you a bodyguard or two.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You haven't ever needed to lift a finger in your line of business?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I've been boating on the rivers for a few dozen years. I've never gotten myself into any of those hairy situations.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I can guarantee your safety if we run into some wild beasts on our journey through the mountains...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But with all the construction around the mountains the past couple years, you won't come across any beasts.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So there aren't any wild beasts... but are there any creatures with metal plates on their backs?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Now what's that about?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I don't know myself.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Where did you see that?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I saw it...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: ...right here.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: This... this is...

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm, it's gone...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You scared it away...

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Need something...?

steps.name: Suspicious Townsfolk
steps.text: Do you have the cup?

steps.name: Suspicious Townsfolk
steps.text: We work for Innkeeper Zheng. He has a small eatery in this town as well. He wants to treat you to lunch.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Street Youth A
steps.text: I really don't understand what Miss Du and the innkeeper are thinking. This is such a pain in the ass...

steps.name: Street Youth B
steps.text: First, they want us to steal the goods, then they want us to ensure no one makes off with it, and they even want us to get in the employer's way... Hm?

steps.name: Street Youth B
steps.text: Hey, get up. Take a look over there...

steps.name: Street Youth B
steps.text: Stop right there...!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hello, sir. How may I help you?

steps.name: Street Youth B
steps.text: Uh... Umm... I'm traveling right now, but I lost my wallet. I don't know nobody here. Think you can help me out?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Did all of you lose your wallets together?

steps.name: Street Youth B
steps.text: N-No, we... uh... we couldn't all be bothered to bring our backpacks with us, you know? So we put our cameras and wallets and whatnot all in one bag. It's the bag that we lost.

steps.name: Street Youth A
steps.text: We ain't gonna ask much from you. Just head back down the mountain and call the cops at the hotel there. I promise it'll be worth your while. Please, help us.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Look at the time already... Sundown here comes early, huh?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nothing, mate, how do we get to the Liang estate again?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: This way, Benefactor...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Shangshu's streets and alleys are vivid and colorful. There's a certain charm to gazing out at the mountains in the distance and the markets below from atop the skyscrapers here.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: It's an entirely different scenery than what you'd find in Kou-wu.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Right. It's got a nice vibe, and the view is great. Not to mention, when the wind blows, you can sometimes smell the rust.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Am I right?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It has been a while since my blade was last unsheathed. How could it possibly rust?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You need us for something?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Of course... Rhodes Island has gotten too involved.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So you've been digging up dirt on us?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Here's a Yanese idiom you might like, Miss Kroos. 'Justice casts a wide net.'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A medical company that strives to rescue all Infected and sees them as equals, regardless of their race, status, and wealth—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —Even the purest of mountain springs must be no match for Rhodes Island in purity.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Thanks for the compliment.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Oh, please don't get the wrong idea... I didn't mean that as a threat.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: After all, if Rhodes Island was a dishonest organization, you two would be in jail right now.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In other words, I would like you two to see our current situation as a form of trust.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Should I say thanks?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: However, Infected should not be wandering about in such a bustling part of town out in the open. Safety remains a concern, after all.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Would you follow me? Let's take this somewhere else.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (What should we do, Benefactor? This kid's sketchy through and through.)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Not necessarily, and it's not like we have a choice...)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Sure, let's go somewhere else.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Very well. I see you two are of formidable talent as well. I'll wait for you at the top of the tower to the north in a quarter hour.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is that what you guys call qinggong in Yanese martial arts?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: More or less. Of course, considering his martial prowess, he's no normal man.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Alright, fine... He's extraordinary, actually.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I don't see you get this serious often.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Haha, you jest, my benefactor. I'm always solemn and serious about every last detail.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: To possess such fine skills at his age... He must have studied under a distinguished master to hone his extraordinary talent. Even that might be an understatement. His abilities are likely beyond our imagination.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Like I was saying, if he had that bull of a mandarin for a bodyguard, he is not to be taken lightly.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They know about Nian and Dusk. Obviously, they know about Mr. Lee too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Dusk said... We have to find the goblet's master first.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Getting involved with a Yanese mandarin, though... Amiya's going to chew me out when we get back...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *Sigh*, if only the Doctor... Guess we can't always count on the Doctor, huh...
